Flash

Place 2 cores from an opposing Spirit/Ultimate in the opposing Reserve.
After this effect, open this card and keep it in your hand.

You may discard the top 2 cards of your deck. For each Spirit card among them with "Godzilla" / "Destoroyah" in its card name, add 1 Red symbol to this Spirit.

All your Spirits with "Godzilla" / "Type 3 Kiryu" in their card names are not affected by the effects of opposing Spirits/Ultimates.

Flash

After this effect, discard this card, or swap it with your Refreshed Spirit with cost 6 or more that has "Godzilla" in its card name. If in battle, the battle continues.

By discarding 1 card from your hand, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with BP equal to or less than this Spirit's BP.
